hotel_knowledge_base.title: Room Categories and Features
hotel_knowledge_base.content: GrandStay Hospitality Group offers a variety of room types designed for both business and leisure travelers. Guests can choose from Deluxe Rooms, Executive Suites, Family Residences, and the signature Grand Presidential Suite. Each room features high-speed Wi-Fi, ergonomic workstations, premium bedding, rainfall showers, and 24-hour room service. Suites additionally include separate living areas, marble bathrooms, and access to the GrandStay Club Lounge where complimentary breakfast and evening cocktails are served daily.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Dining and Culinary Experiences
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Guests can indulge in world-class dining at GSH’s flagship restaurant, The Ember Room, known for its international buffet and live cooking stations. For fine dining, Le Vigne offers a curated selection of global wines paired with seasonal tasting menus. The SkyBar on the 25th floor provides a stunning view of the city skyline with signature cocktails and small plates. Guests seeking casual dining can visit Café Azul, open 24/7 for coffee, pastries, and light meals.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Wellness and Fitness Facilities
hotel_knowledge_base.content: The GrandStay Wellness Center features a fully equipped gym with Technogym equipment, yoga studios, and an indoor lap pool. The Solace Spa offers signature treatments such as aromatherapy massages and hydrotherapy rituals using locally sourced oils. Guests may also book private sessions with fitness trainers or join group yoga classes available every morning at 7 a.m.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Business and Event Spaces
hotel_knowledge_base.content: The GrandStay Convention Wing features 12 meeting rooms and a Grand Ballroom capable of hosting up to 800 guests. Each space includes high-definition projectors, digital whiteboards, and on-site technical support. Our Executive Lounge offers co-working pods, printing facilities, and complimentary refreshments throughout the day. Dedicated event planners assist with logistics, catering, and décor to ensure seamless corporate or social functions.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Swimming Pool and Recreation
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Guests can relax at our temperature-controlled outdoor infinity pool, which overlooks the city skyline. Pool attendants are available to serve drinks and light snacks, and cabanas can be reserved in advance. Families can enjoy the children’s splash area adjacent to the main pool. Evening pool lighting transforms the area into a serene ambiance, ideal for relaxation after a long day.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Check-In and Check-Out Policy
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Standard check-in time at GrandStay properties is 3:00 p.m., while check-out is at 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out requests are subject to availability and may incur additional charges. Guests arriving early can store luggage with the concierge team or enjoy amenities such as the lounge and café until rooms are ready.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Cancellations made 48 hours prior to arrival are eligible for a full refund. For cancellations within 48 hours or in case of no-show, one night’s room charge including taxes will apply. Non-refundable and promotional rates follow their own terms, clearly indicated at the time of booking. Refunds for eligible cancellations are typically processed within 5–7 business days.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: GrandStay Rewards Loyalty Program
hotel_knowledge_base.content: The GrandStay Rewards Program allows members to earn points for every night’s stay, dining, and spa services. Points can be redeemed for free nights, room upgrades, or exclusive experiences. Members also enjoy early check-in, late checkout, and personalized welcome amenities. Enrollment is free, and membership tiers—Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond—offer increasing benefits.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Pet Policy
hotel_knowledge_base.content: GrandStay is a pet-friendly hotel chain. Guests may bring up to two pets per room with a combined weight limit of 30 kg. A one-time cleaning fee applies per stay. Pet-friendly floors are designated to ensure the comfort of all guests. Complimentary pet beds and bowls are available upon request at check-in.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Accepted Payment Methods
hotel_knowledge_base.content: We accept all major credit and debit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Guests may also pay using digital wallets such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Alipay. Corporate clients can arrange direct billing agreements upon approval. Cash payments are accepted for incidental charges but require a valid credit card on file for deposits.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: City Heritage Walking Tour
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Guests can join the GrandStay Heritage Walk every morning at 9:00 a.m. led by local guides. The tour explores historic architecture, markets, and landmarks within walking distance of the hotel. Highlights include the Old Town Square, the River Promenade, and the Artisan Alley. Reservations can be made at the concierge desk, and bottled water is provided.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Nearby Fine Dining Restaurants
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Within a 10-minute walk from the hotel, guests can experience renowned local cuisine. ‘Maison d’Or’ serves French-inspired dishes with locally sourced ingredients, while ‘Saffron Table’ offers authentic regional flavors. For a casual evening, ‘Harbor View Grill’ provides seafood and live music. Our concierge team can assist with table reservations and transportation arrangements.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Shopping and Entertainment District
hotel_knowledge_base.content: The GrandStay property is conveniently located near Crescent Mall and The Plaza Arcade. Guests will find international brands, artisan boutiques, and entertainment options such as a 12-screen cinema and gaming arena. Evening visitors can enjoy live jazz performances and open-air cafés lining the boulevard.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Outdoor Adventure and Day Trips
hotel_knowledge_base.content: For guests seeking adventure, the concierge can arrange day trips to the Blue Hills National Park, just 45 minutes away. Activities include guided hiking, mountain biking, and scenic picnics. Transportation, meals, and park permits can be organized through our tour partners for a seamless experience.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Cultural and Museum Experiences
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Art enthusiasts can explore the National Museum of Modern Art, located 2 km from the hotel. The museum showcases both local and international artists and frequently hosts special exhibitions. Guests may also attend evening cultural shows featuring traditional dance and live orchestra performances arranged by our concierge team.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: How do I request an airport transfer?
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Guests can request airport transfers directly during booking or by contacting the concierge at least 24 hours prior to arrival. We offer both private sedans and shared shuttle services. The hotel representative will meet guests at the arrivals terminal holding a GrandStay sign. Airport transfers are chargeable and billed to the room account upon check-in.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Breakfast inclusion depends on the selected room package. Rooms booked under the ‘Bed & Breakfast’ plan include a full buffet breakfast served at The Ember Room from 6:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. Guests staying on room-only rates may purchase breakfast separately. In-room dining options for breakfast are also available upon request.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Can I make special requests before arrival?
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Yes, guests can share preferences such as room location, pillow type, or dietary restrictions during booking or through our pre-arrival form. The concierge and housekeeping teams will ensure arrangements are made prior to check-in. While all requests are subject to availability, GrandStay strives to personalize every stay experience.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: What amenities are available for families with children?
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Family guests can request cribs, rollaway beds, and baby-proofing kits at no additional cost. Our ‘Little Explorers’ program includes a children’s playroom, weekend movie screenings, and kid-friendly dining menus. Babysitting services are available upon request with advance notice of 4 hours.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Does the hotel offer currency exchange services?
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Yes, currency exchange services are available at the front desk for major global currencies. Exchange rates are updated daily according to the official financial exchange board. For large transactions, guests may be referred to our partnering bank branch located within the hotel complex.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Safety Tips for City Exploration
hotel_knowledge_base.content: While the city is generally safe for tourists, guests are advised to stay alert in crowded areas and safeguard personal belongings. Avoid carrying large sums of cash, and prefer using digital or card payments. When using taxis, ensure they are registered or book rides via recommended apps. Our concierge can provide verified transportation contacts and city maps.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Cultural Etiquette and Customs
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Local residents value politeness and modest attire, particularly in religious or traditional areas. A simple greeting and a smile go a long way. When visiting temples or shrines, remove shoes before entering and avoid public displays of affection. Guests are encouraged to ask our staff for guidance to ensure a respectful and enriching visit.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Best Seasons to Visit
hotel_knowledge_base.content: The ideal time to visit is between October and March when temperatures are mild and outdoor attractions are most enjoyable. Summer months can be humid, making it perfect for indoor activities like museum tours and spa retreats. Festive periods, such as the annual City Lights Festival in December, offer vibrant cultural experiences and exclusive hotel packages.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Public Transportation and Getting Around
hotel_knowledge_base.content: Guests can easily navigate the city using the metro system, which connects all major districts. Smart travel cards are available for purchase at the concierge desk. Alternatively, guests may rent bicycles or request private cars through the hotel’s preferred ride partners. Maps and route recommendations are available upon request.

hotel_knowledge_base.title: Packing Essentials for a Comfortable Stay
hotel_knowledge_base.content: We recommend packing lightweight, breathable clothing, especially for daytime excursions. Include a light jacket for cooler evenings and comfortable footwear for city walks. Don’t forget sunscreen, insect repellent, and reusable water bottles for day trips. Power adapters are available upon request from the front desk.
